notes.title: First day update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, dear friend and players![/h2]

This update includes: 

[list]
[*] More improved optimization 
[*] Fixed dialogues
[*] Improved system for choosing the language of the narrative/dialogues
[/list]

And also:

[list]
[*] Correction of phone errors, and tasks related to it. 
[*] A lot of minor fixes related to the character, artificial intelligence and the environment.
[/list]

[u][b]We study your feedback and comments, we try to adjust our roadmap along with your feedback and suggestions.
Your feedback is very helpful in the development of the game, keep up the good work![/b][/u]
[h3]Thx everyone![/h3]

[b]Keep in touch![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.notes:
[h1]We will fix bugs:[/h1]
• Remote control machine
• Changed interface in mini games [i](Car, drawing board, piano)[/i]
• Fixed bugs in music and sounds.
• Fixed a bug with the appearance of the cursor in the phone
• Phone bugs fixed
• Slightly refactored the code [i](Which will give a bit of an increase in optimization)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43116429/bb10764ffd87eecad89c901a710d56209d3dd3be.gif[/img]

[h1]What's new added:[/h1]
• When they take away our panties, the girls laugh at us.
• A test voice synthesizer appeared in the dialogues [i](It is barely audible due to the lack of high-quality sounds. Sounds are still in development)[/i]
• Added a red circle to visually display the scope of the girls [i](during attack)[/i]
• Added a white circle to visually display the scope of the girls (If you get into the zone, you will be attacked)
• Improved post-processing
• Slightly changed the appearance of the level
• Now the rescuers are slightly different from each other [i](Hairstyles, hair color and eye color have been changed)[/i]
• Piano now works when hovering over keys
• Girls got sounds and FX on the stands
• Girl's head has become a little more dynamic in the dialogues[i] (Now they are trying to look at your face from the stairs)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43116429/8ba9db33d9e30c1d0185b4adc01e30f136db81f6.gif[/img]
